description: The workspace's CONFIG project: configuration only, no app code. It owns the workspace-wide configuration (environments, sign-in methods, branding, email, identity providers, custom domain), one section per environment under .thoryn/environments/. Render the files below, then delete this manifest.

workspace.description: Slug of the Thoryn workspace this project configures.

sandboxEnvironment.description: Slug of the first sandbox environment (section .thoryn/environments/sandbox). The production section declares it.

productionWorkloadIdentityClientId.description: clientId (wi_…) of the PRODUCTION workload identity trust for this repository. It pins the GitHub environment below.

sandboxWorkloadIdentityClientId.description: clientId (wi_…) of the workload identity trust for this repository in the sandbox environment.

githubEnvironment.description: The GitHub environment the production trust pins; the production job runs in it (add required reviewers there).

githubOwner.description: GitHub user or organization that owns the repository (the trusts' pinned owner).

githubRepository.description: Repository name, without the owner (the trusts' pinned repository).

actionsVariables.THORYN_ISSUER: Platform base issuer the thoryn CLI signs in to, e.g. https://auth.stg.thoryn.org. Required until the CLI ships a built-in production issuer.
